dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: H-Hello! I'm counting on you to bring my muse back!

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: If I delay again, I bet Miss Moriko'll... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing me the pictures. What a lovely place Mondstadt is!

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Look at that huge tree... How I wish I could stand in its shade and draw...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Thank you. Wow! I've never imagined an inn as big as this one...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: To be able to build an inn out in the wild and manage it so well, its owner must be a very capable person...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: The panoramic view of the snow mountain is the very definition of perfection!

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Awesome! I'm gonna draw a big panoramic picture of it!

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Then I'll send a smaller one to Ms. Moriko. She has always loved the sight of snowy mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: To think you could catch the split second when the lightning stroke — you're such a pro.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Well, I'm quite curious about the Great Wolf King of the North...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: What a most unusual angle... Thank you. Without you, I could've never thought of drawing it this way.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Finally got some ideas for several of my illustrations. Let's hope Miss Moriko isn't in a hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Thank you for taking pictures for me. Miss Moriko came by again the other day to check my progress.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Somehow everyone's started writing light novels lately.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: I heard that new manuscripts kept coming in at Yae Publishing House and a few rising stars had emerged.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: *sigh* I gotta match their spirit. I might make myself a bit more popular if I draw illustrations for a well-written novel.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Another busy day of picture-taking, isn't it? Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I met a writer whom I'd drawn illustrations for.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: He says he's writing a novel with the theme of sword fighting and is looking for someone to design the costumes and scenes for him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you find his novels?

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Hmm... He's an excellent writer. His editor says he's like a poet.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Wonder if he's in the poet mode when writing this novel...

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: What an ingenious idea to take a picture from this angle! It's great!

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: I do hope Mr. Xavier'll like my posters.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: He says he'll use these posters to promote his film.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: I can't remember its name. Uh... The story seems to center around a samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Asagiri
dialogues.text: Anyway, I hope everything goes well with the shooting.
